§6Schrabidic Acid§f

§aRadioactive, corrosive, flows like water but spreads like lava. Handle with extreme care.§f

§bSchrabidic Acid§f is the chemical backbone of schrabidium processing. NFPA ratings are §e4/0/4§f, meaning it is an acid and a radiological hazard. It heavily irradiates players on contact.

§6Make It§f (Chemical Factory, 5s, 5.0 kHE/t):
§b•§f §e8,000 mB§f Schrabidium Trisulfide
§b•§f §e6,000 mB§f Hydrogen Peroxide
§b•§f 1 Ionized Particle
§b•§f Output: §e16,000 mB§f Schrabidic Acid

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f Ferric Schrabidate, 250 mB per Iron Powder
§b•§f PUREX schrabidium extraction, 500 mB per run, yields 0.75 ingots
§b•§f Schrabidium Trisulfide precursor chain

§ePS:§f Stockpile hydrogen peroxide and get a reliable ionized particle source from fusion before scaling. You need trisulfide too: Schrabidium Powder + Sulfur + H2O2 -> Trisulfide.
